# Flecs 4.1.0

Unmodified upstream amalgamated sources from tag `v4.1.0`:

- https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/blob/v4.1.0/distr/flecs.h
- https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/blob/v4.1.0/distr/flecs.c
- https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/blob/v4.1.0/LICENSE

Built as a static C99 library and linked into `qc_game`. The upstream distribution header already defines `flecs_STATIC`. No HTTP server or Explorer endpoint is enabled by the game.

See `docs/FLECS.md` for integration, threading and lifetime rules.
